<mxfile host="app.diagrams.net" modified="2026-10-03T02:00:00.000Z" agent="Mozilla/5.0" version="24.0.0" type="embed"> <diagram id="shopcore-system" name="ShopCore System Architecture"> <mxGraphModel dx="1400" dy="900" grid="1" gridSize="10" guides="1" tooltips="1" connect="1" arrows="1" fold="1" page="1" pageScale="1" pageWidth="1240" pageHeight="920" math="0" shadow="0"> <root> <mxCell id="0" /> <mxCell id="1" parent="0" />
<!-- Header --> <mxCell id="header" value="<b>ShopCore — System Architecture &amp; Trust Boundaries</b><br>C4 Container &amp; Component Model • Strict Integer-Money Math • Atomic Stock Locks • Idempotent Stripe Webhooks" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#0F172A;strokeColor=none;fontColor=#FFFFFF;align=left;spacingLeft=20;fontSize=14;" vertex="1" parent="1"> <mxGeometry x="40" y="30" width="1160" height="70" as="geometry" /> </mxCell>
<!-- Client Boundary --> <mxCell id="client-boundary" value="TRUST BOUNDARY: PUBLIC CLIENT SURFACES (UNTRUSTED BROWSER)" style="swimlane;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;dashed=1;dashPattern=6 4;strokeColor=#94A3B8;fillColor=#F8FAFC;fontColor=#64748B;fontSize=11;startSize=26;" vertex="1" parent="1"> <mxGeometry x="40" y="120" width="1160" height="120" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="b2c-client" value="<b>B2C Customer Storefront</b><br>Catalog browsing, cart, checkout<br><font color="#60A5FA">React 18 / Next.js Client Comp</font>" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#EFF6FF;strokeColor=#3B82F6;fontColor=#1E3A8A;fontSize=11;" vertex="1" parent="client-boundary"> <mxGeometry x="30" y="36" width="340" height="68" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="b2b-client" value="<b>B2B Procurement Portal</b><br>Tiered volume pricing, wholesale POs<br><font color="#60A5FA">Authenticated session, tax ID check</font>" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#EFF6FF;strokeColor=#3B82F6;fontColor=#1E3A8A;fontSize=11;" vertex="1" parent="client-boundary"> <mxGeometry x="410" y="36" width="340" height="68" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="admin-client" value="<b>Admin Operations Console</b><br>Inventory adjustments, order fulfillment<br><font color="#60A5FA">Strict RBAC, HTTP-only JWT</font>" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#EFF6FF;strokeColor=#3B82F6;fontColor=#1E3A8A;fontSize=11;" vertex="1" parent="client-boundary"> <mxGeometry x="790" y="36" width="340" height="68" as="geometry" /> </mxCell>
<!-- Application Server Boundary --> <mxCell id="app-boundary" value="APPLICATION SERVER BOUNDARY: NEXT.JS 14 APP ROUTER (NODE.JS RUNTIME)" style="swimlane;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;strokeColor=#8B5CF6;strokeWidth=2;fillColor=#FFFFFF;fontColor=#6D28D9;fontSize=12;startSize=30;" vertex="1" parent="1"> <mxGeometry x="40" y="280" width="820" height="420" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="middleware" value="<b>Edge Middleware &amp; Guard</b><br>• HTTP-only JWT verification<br>• RBAC role validation (/admin)<br>• Route-level rate limiting" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#F5F3FF;strokeColor=#8B5CF6;fontColor=#4C1D95;fontSize=11;align=left;spacingLeft=10;" vertex="1" parent="app-boundary"> <mxGeometry x="24" y="48" width="240" height="85" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="api-routes" value="<b>API Routes &amp; Actions</b><br>• /api/checkout (Order init)<br>• /api/webhooks/stripe<br>• /api/inventory/reserve" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#F5F3FF;strokeColor=#8B5CF6;fontColor=#4C1D95;fontSize=11;align=left;spacingLeft=10;" vertex="1" parent="app-boundary"> <mxGeometry x="288" y="48" width="240" height="85" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="idempotency" value="<b>Idempotency Coordinator</b><br>• Idempotency-Key header hash<br>• In-flight lock &amp; replay guard<br>• Prevents double-charging" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#FFFBEB;strokeColor=#F59E0B;fontColor=#78350F;fontSize=11;align=left;spacingLeft=10;" vertex="1" parent="app-boundary"> <mxGeometry x="552" y="48" width="244" height="85" as="geometry" /> </mxCell>
<mxCell id="pricing-engine" value="<b>Zero-Trust Pricing Engine</b><br>• All math in integer cents<br>• Recomputes all totals from DB<br>• Coupon discount validation<br>• Tax &amp; shipping calculation" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#ECFDF5;strokeColor=#10B981;fontColor=#064E3B;fontSize=11;align=left;spacingLeft=10;" vertex="1" parent="app-boundary"> <mxGeometry x="24" y="168" width="240" height="110" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="inventory-lock" value="<b>Inventory Reservation Lock</b><br>• Atomic conditional decrement<br>• WHERE stock &gt;= requested_qty<br>• 15-minute lock expiration TTL<br>• Race-condition safe" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#ECFDF5;strokeColor=#10B981;fontColor=#064E3B;fontSize=11;align=left;spacingLeft=10;" vertex="1" parent="app-boundary"> <mxGeometry x="288" y="168" width="240" height="110" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="order-fsm" value="<b>Order State Machine</b><br>• PENDING -&gt; RESERVED<br>• RESERVED -&gt; PAID (Webhook)<br>• PAID -&gt; PROCESSING -&gt; SHIPPED<br>• Immutable event transitions" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#ECFDF5;strokeColor=#10B981;fontColor=#064E3B;fontSize=11;align=left;spacingLeft=10;" vertex="1" parent="app-boundary"> <mxGeometry x="552" y="168" width="244" height="110" as="geometry" /> </mxCell>
<mxCell id="audit-subsystem" value="<b>Stripe Webhook Reconciliation &amp; Audit Trail Subsystem</b><br>• HMAC-SHA256 signature verification via raw request buffer (STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET)<br>• Event deduplication via processed_events table: guarantees exact-once execution<br>• Audit trail logging: records actor, IP, timestamp, price delta, and inventory mutations" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#F8FAFC;strokeColor=#64748B;fontColor=#1E293B;fontSize=11;align=left;spacingLeft=12;" vertex="1" parent="app-boundary"> <mxGeometry x="24" y="312" width="772" height="88" as="geometry" /> </mxCell>
<!-- External Boundary --> <mxCell id="ext-boundary" value="EXTERNAL THIRD-PARTY APIS" style="swimlane;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;dashed=1;dashPattern=6 4;strokeColor=#F43F5E;fillColor=#FFF1F2;fontColor=#E11D48;fontSize=11;startSize=26;" vertex="1" parent="1"> <mxGeometry x="885" y="280" width="315" height="420" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="stripe-ext" value="<b>Stripe Payment Gateway</b><br>• Hosted Checkout Sessions<br>• PaymentIntent lifecycle<br>• Webhook dispatch (event bus)<br><font color="#FB7185">PCI-DSS delegated scope</font>" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#FFFFFF;strokeColor=#F43F5E;fontColor=#9F1239;fontSize=11;" vertex="1" parent="ext-boundary"> <mxGeometry x="18" y="48" width="278" height="110" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="email-ext" value="<b>Transactional Email (SMTP)</b><br>• Order confirmation receipts<br>• Shipping tracking updates" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#FFFFFF;strokeColor=#F43F5E;fontColor=#9F1239;fontSize=11;" vertex="1" parent="ext-boundary"> <mxGeometry x="18" y="178" width="278" height="95" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="b2b-bank-ext" value="<b>B2B Bank Transfer / UTR</b><br>• Offline invoice PO matching<br>• Customer UTR receipt upload<br>• Manual admin reconciliation" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#FFFFFF;strokeColor=#F43F5E;fontColor=#9F1239;fontSize=11;" vertex="1" parent="ext-boundary"> <mxGeometry x="18" y="293" width="278" height="107" as="geometry" /> </mxCell>
<!-- Database Layer --> <mxCell id="db-boundary" value="DATA PERSISTENCE LAYER: PRISMA ORM &amp; SQLITE (WAL MODE)" style="swimlane;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;strokeColor=#6366F1;strokeWidth=2;fillColor=#EEF2FF;fontColor=#3730A3;fontSize=12;startSize=28;" vertex="1" parent="1"> <mxGeometry x="40" y="720" width="820" height="110" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="db-products" value="<b>products</b><br>id, price_cents, stock<br>version, is_active" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#FFFFFF;strokeColor=#6366F1;fontSize=10;" vertex="1" parent="db-boundary"> <mxGeometry x="20" y="36" width="180" height="60" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="db-orders" value="<b>orders &amp; items</b><br>id, user_id, status<br>subtotal_cents, tax_cents" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#FFFFFF;strokeColor=#6366F1;fontSize=10;" vertex="1" parent="db-boundary"> <mxGeometry x="216" y="36" width="180" height="60" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="db-reserves" value="<b>inventory_reservations</b><br>id, product_id, qty<br>expires_at, status" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#FFFFFF;strokeColor=#6366F1;fontSize=10;" vertex="1" parent="db-boundary"> <mxGeometry x="412" y="36" width="190" height="60" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="db-audit" value="<b>idempotency &amp; audit</b><br>key_hash, response_json<br>processed_events, logs" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#FFFFFF;strokeColor=#6366F1;fontSize=10;" vertex="1" parent="db-boundary"> <mxGeometry x="618" y="36" width="182" height="60" as="geometry" /> </mxCell>
<!-- Edges --> <mxCell id="edge1" style="edgeStyle=orthogonalEdgeStyle;rounded=0;orthogonalLoop=1;jettySize=auto;html=1;strokeColor=#2563EB;strokeWidth=2;" edge="1" parent="1" source="b2c-client" target="api-routes"> <mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="edge2" style="edgeStyle=orthogonalEdgeStyle;rounded=0;orthogonalLoop=1;jettySize=auto;html=1;strokeColor=#F43F5E;strokeWidth=2;" edge="1" parent="1" source="api-routes" target="stripe-ext"> <mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="edge3" style="edgeStyle=orthogonalEdgeStyle;rounded=0;orthogonalLoop=1;jettySize=auto;html=1;strokeColor=#4F46E5;strokeWidth=2;" edge="1" parent="1" source="inventory-lock" target="db-reserves"> <mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> </root> </mxGraphModel> </diagram> </mxfile>

g.text: C4 Container & Component Model • Strict Integer-Money Math (cents) • Atomic Stock Locks • Idempotent Stripe Webhooks
TRUST BOUNDARY: PUBLIC CLIENT SURFACES (UNTRUSTED BROWSER)
Catalog browsing, cart state, checkout initiation
Volume tier pricing, wholesale purchase orders, invoices
Authenticated session, business tax ID validation
Inventory adjustment, order fulfillment, audit review
Strict RBAC session, HTTP-only JWT verification
APPLICATION SERVER BOUNDARY: NEXT.JS 14 APP ROUTER (NODE.JS RUNTIME)
Stripe Webhook Reconciliation & Audit Trail Subsystem
• HMAC-SHA256 signature verification via raw request buffer (STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET)
• Event deduplication via processed_events table: guarantees exact-once execution
• Audit trail logging: records actor, IP, timestamp, price delta, and inventory mutations
DATA PERSISTENCE LAYER: PRISMA ORM & SQLITE (WAL MODE)
